packageRules.description: napi-rs no longer runs on Node 18 as of v3.5.0

wasm-pack 0.14.0 on npm references drager/wasm-pack (a fork) instead of wasm-bindgen/wasm-pack in its binary.js, causing a 404 when downloading the binary. Pin until fixed. See https://github.com/wasm-bindgen/wasm-pack/issues/1577
stacker 0.1.24+ requires windows-sys >=0.60 which uses windows-link instead of windows-targets, breaking the x86_64-pc-windows-gnu (MinGW) build. Pin until upstream fixes this.

cc 1.4.7 passes --target=arm-unknown-linux-gnueabihf to clang, which breaks the armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf build when --gcc-toolchain points to the napi cross toolchain. Also pinned in rust/bindings_napi/Cargo.toml because lock file maintenance ignores allowedVersions. Pin until upstream fixes this. See https://github.com/rust-lang/cc-rs/issues/1940
cc 1.4.6 does not compile against the regenerated bindings of find-msvc-tools 0.1.13. Pinned together with cc in rust/bindings_napi/Cargo.toml.
this restriction should not be updated by renovate.
